technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Data approximated with data from nickel mining and benefication. For the further treatment the process "reduction of oxides" is approximated by stoechiometric calculation - assuming a yield of 95% - and approximations for energy consumption from other chemical plants. No emissions are assumed for this treatment process.

# Included processes
Raw materials, land-use, auxillaries and energy consumption as well as emissions to air and water for extraction step. Auxillaries and energy consumption estimated for further treatment step. No emissions for further treatment taken into account. Overburden and tailing material from process together with losses of product not taken into account.
